name: duplicata_cerc_payload_emissao
description: Monta o struct 'payload' do subfluxo EMISSAO de DUPLICATA/CERC. Faz explode de assinantes e cedentes, calcula contrato_rank + lote_index (agrupamento por 300 contratos), e monta arrays 'signer_list' e 'documents' via collect_list over (partition by id_cessao, lote_index). 4 outputs.

transformations.name: contrato_rank
transformations.expression: dense_rank() over (partition by id_cessao order by numero_contrato)

transformations.name: signer_item
transformations.expression: struct(assinantes.email as email, assinantes.nome as name, assinantes.pessoa_estrangeira as foreignPerson, assinantes.documento as document, assinantes.tipo_autenticacao as authType)

transformations.name: doc_input_struct
transformations.expression: struct(struct(nome_sacado as value) as sacado_nome, struct(numero_contrato as value) as duplicata_numero, struct(logradouro_sacado as value) as sacado_endereco, struct(municipio as value) as sacado_municipio, struct(uf as value) as sacado_uf, struct(valor_face_parcela as value) as duplicata_valor, struct(documento_sacado as value) as sacado_cnpj_cpf, struct('municipio' as value) as sacado_praca_pagamento, struct(data_emissao_duplicata as value) as duplicata_data_emissao, struct(cep_sacado as value) as sacado_cep, struct(data_vencimento_parcela as value) as duplicata_vencimento, struct(valor_face_parcela as value) as fatura_valor_por_extenso, struct(cnpj_fundo as value) as endossatario_cpf_cnpj, struct(valor_face_parcela as value) as fatura_valor, struct(numero_nf_duplicata as value) as fatura_numero, struct(nome_fundo as value) as endossatario_nome, struct(lpad(cast(documento_cedente as string), 14, '0') as value) as cedente_cnpj_cpf, struct(nome_cedente as value) as cedente_nome, struct(cedentes.cedente_municipio as value) as cedente_municipio, struct(cedentes.cedente_rua as value) as cedente_rua, struct(cedentes.cedente_agencia as value) as cedente_agencia, struct(cedentes.cedente_conta as value) as cedente_conta, struct(cedentes.cedente_bairro as value) as cedente_bairro, struct(cedentes.cedente_inscricao_estadual as value) as cedente_inscricao_estadual, struct(cedentes.cedente_banco as value) as cedente_banco, struct(cedentes.cedente_telefone as value) as cedente_telefone, struct(cedentes.cedente_uf as value) as cedente_uf, struct(cedentes.cedente_cep as value) as cedente_cep, struct(cedentes.cedente_inscricao_municipal as value) as cedente_inscricao_municipal)

transformations.name: doc_item
transformations.expression: struct(concat('Connectoway_', numero_contrato) as fileExternalReference, produto as product, struct(cast(tipo_template as int) as type, referencia_template as externalReference, doc_input_struct as inputs) as template)

transformations.name: payload
transformations.expression: struct(id_vert as id_externo, documento_participante as participant_document, id_cessao as envelope_external_reference, signer_list as signer_list, documents as documents)

transformations.name: headers
transformations.expression: array(struct(cast('type' as string) as key, cast('REGISTRO' as binary) as value), struct(cast('kind' as string) as key, cast('ENVIO' as binary) as value))
